svg.title: Iggy event-driven architecture
svg.desc: Event-driven architecture for Iggy: producers publish messages into streams, topics, and partitions; Iggy server persists to streaming log; consumers and consumer groups poll or receive messages independently. Producers and consumers are fully decoupled through the persistent streaming log.

g.text: Event producers — publish messages to Iggy

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do application producers publish messages to Iggy?')
sendPrompt('Can multiple independent producers publish to the same Iggy stream?')
sendPrompt('How do services publish events to Iggy?')

g.text: Receives messages · validates · persists to disk · routes to partitions

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is a Stream in Iggy?')
sendPrompt('What is a Topic in Iggy?')
sendPrompt('Can a stream have multiple topics in Iggy?')
sendPrompt('How do partitions work in Iggy?')
sendPrompt('Do partitions allow parallel consumption in Iggy?')

svg.text: poll or receive · independent offset per consumer/group

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does a single consumer poll messages from Iggy?')
sendPrompt('How do consumer groups share message processing in Iggy?')
sendPrompt('Can consumers replay messages from Iggy?')

svg.text: Producers never call consumer logic — fully decoupled through persistent streaming log · consumers process at their own pace
